newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen rising but summer lull draws near.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen rising but summer lull draws near.

text.p: Shares were expected to trade slighty higher on generally positive sentiment as interest rates opened lower on Monday and Wall Street closed higher on Friday, but trade was seen quiet, brokers said.
"Many institutions have already withdrawn, the market could rise but that would be on international factors," one said.

Brokers said it was difficult to predict the level of summer volume since Nokia and some other shares can sometimes be very active on purely foreign interest. U.S. CPI data on Tuesday -- forecast up 0.2 pct mth/mth and 2.4 pct yr/yr -- was the next key indicator, one broker said.
"It would of course be a huge disappointment if it were inflationary," said one broker.
